title: [Automated] Draft docs (kgateway): jwt: add AllowMissingOrFailed validation mode
body:
# Documentation triage 1 candidates, 1 triaged, 0 skipped. | Product | new-feature | | --- | --- | | kgateway | 1 | ## New surface: no page documents this yet ### [kgateway-dev/kgateway#14667](https://github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/pull/14667) — jwt: add AllowMissingOrFailed validation mode - **Product:** kgateway (upstream) → `kgateway-dev/kgateway.dev` - **Docs version:** envoy/main - **Release note:** Add `validationMode: AllowMissingOrFailed` to the JWT GatewayExtension, which verifies JWTs but never rejects a request. Intended for evaluating a JWT policy against live traffic before enforcing it. JWT providers now also record verification failures in the `envoy.filters.http.jwt_authn:failed_status` dynamic metadata, available to access logs in all validation modes. - **Not tested:** no cluster was available, so every command in this diff is unrun — cluster probing disabled for this run
How this page was chosen - **Disposition:** `pr` - **Why:** - code-path rules name an editable target but no page mentions any identifier, so this is new surface rather than a change to something already documented - 2 of 15 candidate page(s) are named by a code-path rule, so a person already recorded that this code affects them and only the choice among them is open; the draft picks one and states which it rejected - **Candidate pages:** - `assets/kgw-docs/pages/security/external-auth.md` (editable here) - `assets/kgw-docs/pages/security/jwt/basic.md` (editable here) - `assets/kgw-docs/pages/security/jwt/claim-based-rbac.md` (editable here) - `assets/kgw-docs/pages/security/jwt/jwt-claim-extraction.md` (editable here) - `assets/kgw-docs/pages/security/oauth/two-backends.md` (editable here) - `assets/kgw-docs/pages/security/oauth2-overview.md` (editable here) - `assets/kgw-docs/pages/security/ratelimit/global.md` (editable here) - `assets/kgw-docs/pages/security/ratelimit/local.md` (editable here) - `content/docs/envoy/main/security/jwt/_index.md` (editable here) - `content/docs/envoy/main/security/jwt/simple/_index.md` (editable here) - `content/docs/envoy/main/security/oauth/_index.md` (editable here) - `content/docs/envoy/main/security/oauth/auth0/_index.md` (editable here) - `content/docs/envoy/main/security/oauth/auth0/access-token.md` (editable here) - `content/docs/envoy/main/security/oauth/auth0/authorization-code.md` (editable here) - `content/docs/envoy/main/security/oauth/auth0/setup.md` (editable here) - **Reference regenerated by:** kgateway-dev/kgateway.dev .github/workflows/update-api-docs.yml
### kgateway-dev/kgateway#14667 - jwt: add AllowMissingOrFailed validation mode - **Product:** kgateway (upstream) -> kgateway-dev/kgateway.dev - **Docs version:** envoy/main; documented in the development tree, which is where unreleased changes go kgateway-dev/kgateway#14667 adds non-enforcing JWT validation to GatewayExtension. Readers can now set `spec.jwt.validationMode: AllowMissingOrFailed` to verify tokens in live traffic without rejecting missing, expired, malformed, or invalid tokens. Valid tokens still populate `claimsToHeaders` and JWT dynamic metadata, while invalid or missing tokens reach the backend without claim headers and failures appear in `envoy.filters.http.jwt_authn:failed_status`. Before this change, `Strict` rejected missing or invalid tokens, and `AllowMissing` allowed only missing tokens while rejecting invalid ones.
How kgateway-14667 was drafted, and what was not verified ## kgateway-dev/kgateway#14667 - jwt: add AllowMissingOrFailed validation mode - **Code PR:** https://github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/pull/14667 - **Code issue:** none linked - **Product:** kgateway (upstream) -> kgateway-dev/kgateway.dev - **Docs version:** envoy/main; documented in the development tree, which is where unreleased changes go - **Category:** new-feature / pr ### Plan, and what changed it - **Planned:** Choose the JWT task page from the new-feature candidates and document `validationMode: AllowMissingOrFailed`. - **Learned:** `assets/kgw-docs/pages/security/jwt/basic.md` already has a `JWT validation modes` section, and `scripts/pr-tracker/feedback.yaml` says JWT configuration belongs there instead of on a section index. - **Did:** Added a main-only `AllowMissingOrFailed` block to the JWT validation modes section and wrote a proposed release note. ### Why a documentation change is necessary The pull request adds a new `AllowMissingOrFailed` enum value for `spec.jwt.validationMode` and adds failure metadata for JWT providers. The generated API reference will list the enum, but the task page currently explains only `Strict` and `AllowMissing`. A reader evaluating JWT policies against live traffic needs the behavior, security caveat, and verification commands in the JWT guide, not only in generated reference. ### What changed on disk .target-docs/assets/kgw-docs/pages/security/jwt/basic.md - Added a version-gated `AllowMissingOrFailed` example, behavior notes, and verification commands under JWT validation modes. .pr-triage/kgateway-14667/proposed-release-note.md - Proposed a feature release-note entry for the new validation mode and failure metadata. ### How to verify this change 1. Apply the GatewayExtension example from the `AllowMissingOrFailed` section, then check the configured mode. ```sh kubectl get gatewayextension selfminted-jwt -n kgateway-system -o jsonpath='{.spec.jwt.validationMode}{"\n"}' ``` The output is `AllowMissingOrFailed`. 2. Send a request with no token, then send a request with an invalid token. ```sh curl -vik http://$INGRESS_GW_ADDRESS:8080/headers -H "host: www.example.com:8080" curl -vik http://$INGRESS_GW_ADDRESS:8080/headers \ -H "host: www.example.com:8080" \ --header "Authorization: Bearer invalid-token" ``` Both responses show `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`, and the invalid-token response does not include the `X-Team` header. 3. Send a request with the valid sample token from the guide. ```sh curl -vik http://$INGRESS_GW_ADDRESS:8080/headers \ -H "host: www.example.com:8080" \ --header "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" ``` The response shows `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` and includes `X-Team: dev`. If access logs include `%DYNAMIC_METADATA(envoy.filters.http.jwt_authn:failed_status)%`, an invalid-token request shows the verification failure metadata. ### Proposed release note Wrote `.pr-triage/kgateway-14667/proposed-release-note.md` because the pull request is labelled `kind/feature`. ### Style review No Vale pass - the target repository has no Vale configuration, and this repository's house style does not apply to it. Ran the structure, STE, shortcode/version-gate, hard-refusal, and diff whitespace checks. One finding applied: split the new validation-mode prose into shorter sentences. ### What was not verified The configuration was not applied to a cluster, so every command in this diff is unrun. `test_env.state` is `unconfigured` because cluster probing was disabled for this run; `docs-setup-env` would be needed to stand one up. `docs-test-config` was not run in this CI sandbox.
